package.description: On-the-go training delivered inside Autodesk software.

en-US.description: On-the-go training delivered inside Autodesk software.
en-US.longDescription: GeT Know-How is a Global eTraining plugin that delivers on-the-go training directly inside Autodesk software, including Revit, AutoCAD, AutoCAD Civil 3D, AutoCAD Plant 3D, Inventor, and Navisworks. Learners receive predictive training suggestions in text, video, audio, and hands-on formats, with content updated alongside Autodesk software releases. Managers can train teams inside project software, share custom company-specific training content, and reduce time spent answering repeat questions.
en-US.name: GeT Know-How

zh-CN.description: 在 Autodesk 软件内直接提供的随用随学培训。
zh-CN.longDescription: GeT Know-How 是 Global eTraining 推出的插件，可直接在 Autodesk 软件内部提供随用随学的培训，支持 Revit、AutoCAD、AutoCAD Civil 3D、AutoCAD Plant 3D、Inventor 和 Navisworks。学员会收到以文字、视频、音频和实操形式呈现的预测性培训建议，内容随 Autodesk 软件版本同步更新。管理者可以让团队在项目软件中接受培训、分享公司专属的自定义培训内容，并减少重复答疑所花费的时间。
